hero.eyebrow: Built by two people · Porto Alegre, BR
hero.title: We build software the way a mosaic is built — small precise units, placed on purpose.
hero.lead: Tessarion Labs is not a company. It is the name we put on the software we build together — Roger and Alice, one apartment in Porto Alegre, one shared backlog.

about.title: What this is
paragraphs: A name, not a company. Tessarion Labs is what two people call their own work: the software we build for ourselves first, and the standard we hold it to.
There is no office and no payroll. There are two people, a shared backlog, and the hours left over after the day job.
The brand, the written specs and the design system exist because we would rather build one product properly than five in a hurry. That is the whole plan.
about.callout: Two people and the hours left over is the entire capacity. One product moves at a time and the other waits. That is the trade, and it is why Taimu and Mascada are both still in development.

people.title: The family

members.name: Roger Oliveira
members.bio: He built a setup where his hands never left the keyboard — Neovim, terminal, no mouse — then found something better and threw it out. He now works by talking: dictation in, audio back, one real argument with the model most days. That is the pattern: he gets to the next thing early and rebuilds around it, which is how eleven years of engineering — ADP, HP, Dell — turned into this. Grumpy, outnumbered by cats, and the reason this exists.

members.name: Alice Ribeiro
members.bio: Came from management, design and social media and kept all three, which is why she can look at ten half-ideas and say which one is real. She decides what ships and when, and then it ships. Systems analysis in parallel. Off the clock she measures K-dramas in bags: every few episodes, another one exists. Front row at a metal show, and the reason anyone leaves this apartment. Takes the work seriously and very little else, this bio included.

photos.alt: Alice Ribeiro, dark hair and a tattooed neck, looking at the camera.
Alice Ribeiro in a close portrait, dark hair falling past her shoulders.

people.lead: Roger has more ideas than a week holds. Alice decides which one ships, and in what order. The other three are cats. Strong personalities, none of them negotiable.
people.together: They cross the country for a show. Weekends are shorter — the motorcycle up the serra, coffee in another town, and a verdict on both before they are home. Sushi is held to the same standard.

items.name: Taimu
paragraphs: If you bill by the hour, the hours have to be right, and the part that fails is remembering them. Taimu lives in the menu bar and keeps the record while you work — start the day, pause, resume, end it — and the month adds itself up against the goal you set.
Nothing leaves the machine. No server, no account, no sync. The record is a JSON file on your own disk, which means it is yours and it will still open in ten years.

items.name: Mascada
paragraphs: You open a finance app when you are already worried. The answer to that is precision, not encouragement. Mascada puts accounts, cards, instalments, subscriptions and debts in one place, and shows a negative balance as a negative balance.
It also answers to an agent. Through a Claude Code skill, an assistant reads and writes the same ledger you do, so recording a purchase can be a sentence instead of a form.

members.name: Char
members.role: Engineering manager. Runs the standup, opinion on every ticket.
members.bio: Books one-on-ones nobody asked for, and ends them the moment he is done.
members.alt: Char, a black and white cat, lying on a grey couch and looking at the camera.

members.name: Joey
members.role: Security engineer. One trusted origin, everything else blocked.
members.bio: Treats the doorbell as a sev-1 and the vacuum cleaner as an active breach.
members.alt: Joey, a large black and white cat, sitting upright in a kitchen doorway.

members.name: Reginaldo
members.role: Principal engineer. Owns the legacy system. Does not pair.
members.bio: Has rejected every proposal since the first release and will not leave a comment.
members.alt: Reginaldo, a long-haired black and white cat, settled into a blue blanket.
